steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Induction training introduces new employees to the business: health and safety, company culture, policies, and basic procedures. It helps new starters settle in quickly and feel valued. | Key Fact: On-the-job training: learning by doing the actual job, guided by an experienced colleague or mentor. It's practical, relevant, and cheap, but the trainer may pass on bad habits and production may slow during training. | Key Fact: Off-the-job training: learning away from the workplace (college courses, workshops, online programmes).
